summary: Well-designed test suite with comprehensive coverage of all task requirements. Strong organization, clear fixtures, and excellent error-scenario testing. Core weaknesses: numeric extremes (very large numbers) and date-range edge cases (ancient/far-future dates) are not tested. The 32+ test cases across 6 files cover business logic (classification, grouping, sorting), output formatting (markdown/JSON), CLI argument parsing, configuration validation, and workflow structure. Test independence and cleanup practices are solid. Would catch most regressions but misses some boundary conditions in numeric/date inputs.
